author: LemmeC
quote:
Things wrong with this game @ 12th December, 2020

- Some characters T-posing. I saw two characters do this in 14 hours of playing.
- Too much loot everywhere, in places that don't make sense
- Loot laying around that you can't pick up
- Hard to see what loot you are actually picking up
- Playing on hard there is a ridiculous amount of health packs just laying everywhere although they are not very useful
- Side quests are just flying at your head left and right without much choice on your part
- You also can't choose what cars to buy and when, you just are obliged to buy them through quests that randomly appear and you have to start with the crappiest one, each time moving up to a little less crappy. It takes the fun out of car shopping.
- Playing on an azerty keyboard **** because your movement keys will probably overlap with unremappable keys
- Some keys don't work right. E.g. I set LCtrl to toggle crouch but it remains Hold To Crouch even though the menu shows differently.
- Sometimes random menus like your messages or character sheet pop open and I have no idea what key I pressed to open them.
- I haven't found much to do besides main quest, side quests and some collectables.
- Weapon and armor mods seem to be pointless because you can't recover them and you are getting better guns and armor for free constantly so you'll probably change everything every 10 minutes. This may improve late game where you might be able to keep your gear for longer than a few minutes.

I still like the game though. It looks amazing, the action is smooth, the shooting precise, there's a lot of ways to develop and upgrade your character, the story is enough to keep you playing, the game runs great for me, it has a good soundtrack and an interesting Deus Ex-y atmosphere...

As it is today I'd give it a 7,5 but I'm sure with a few patches it will score well above 8. With some extra content and variety perhaps 9. And if people start modding this it might become brilliant. You can tell that despite all the delays CD Projekt Red still rushed it. There is much potential here. I hope that either the developers or the mod community make it what it can be. It happened for No Man's Sky, among others...

I chose to give a ten because a lot of people are giving ratings that are unfairly low and I want to counter that. It's not a revolutionary game but it's at least good and in some areas already great.

quote: Waited for a long time to play this on PC because Rockstar likes to treat the PC users that made them succesful in the first place like second class-customers. Finally came out on Steam, bought it, and when I launched it for the first time the widely disliked Social Club launcher, automatically and for reasons I still don't understand, linked the game to an email adress I hadn't used for years and that does not even exist anymore. Contacted Rockstar Support about this and they replied with a looooong list off all sorts of hoops I had to jump through, even to the point where I would have to scan and send a copy of my ID, for the game to be linked to the email I actually use AND bought the game with. I'm not going to be Rockstars trained little **** performing tricks until they feel like I can play the game I already paid for, so I took the Steam Refund and bought myself RE2 and The Master Chief Collection instead. I do not regret anything. Thank god some companies still appreciate their clients. They will continue to receive my money.  See you never Rockstar.
